title: IEEE Student Branch Officially Launched at Cavendish University Uganda
author: Branch Executive Committee
summary: On 6 October 2026, Cavendish University Uganda celebrated the formal inauguration of its IEEE Student Branch during global IEEE Day celebrations at Siyani Campus.
content:
On 6 October 2026, students, faculty, and engineering enthusiasts gathered at the Siyani Campus main auditorium for the formal inauguration of the IEEE Student Branch at Cavendish University Uganda (CUU). The launch coincided with global IEEE Day 2026, celebrating the worldwide technological mission of IEEE.

Opening remarks were delivered by Student Branch Counselor Dr. John Bosco Ssemakula, highlighting the importance of global technical engagement and research literacy for emerging computing and engineering students in Uganda.

Branch Chair Mulondo Andrew outlined the branch's strategic pillars: expanding technical workshops, fielding competitive programming cohorts for IEEEXtreme, and petitioning for dedicated student chapters of the IEEE Computer Society and IEEE Women in Engineering (WIE).
